properties.displayName: UAV S7 - EO/IR Downlink Interception and Frame Injection
properties.description: UAVImagery_CL(실제 컬럼: UAVId, EventType, MsgType 뿐 — FrameSeq/FrameHashValid/SessionId/StreamId 등은 존재하지 않음)에서 EventType='frame_inject'로 태깅된 프레임 주입 이벤트, 또는 동일 1분 구간 내 MsgType 다양성이 비정상적으로 높은 정황(감청 후 중계·재주입으로 인한 메시지 유형 혼입 프록시 신호)을 탐지. MITRE Enterprise ATT&CK: T1557 Adversary-in-the-Middle (Collection/영상 감청·프레임 주입)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let msgTypeDiversityThreshold = 3;
UAVImagery_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| summarize
    TotalEvents = count(),
    InjectCount = countif(EventType == 'frame_inject'),
    DistinctMsgTypes = dcount(MsgType),
    MsgTypeSet = make_set(MsgType),
    EventTypeSet = make_set(EventType)
    by UAVId, bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| where InjectCount > 0 or DistinctMsgTypes >= msgTypeDiversityThreshold
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    InjectCount > 0, strcat('EOIR_다운링크_프레임주입_의심_', tostring(InjectCount), '건'),
    strcat('EOIR_다운링크_MsgType_비정상다양성_', tostring(DistinctMsgTypes), '종'))
| extend Severity = 'High'
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, TotalEvents, InjectCount, DistinctMsgTypes, MsgTypeSet, EventTypeSet, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S7 - EO/IR Downlink Interception and Frame Injection - {{UAVId}}
